feeds.title: Eater Portland
feeds.description: Food news and dining guides for Portland, OR.

feeds.title: Portland Monthly » Eat & Drink
feeds.description: Portland's best restaurants, bars, and food carts, with restaurant listings by cuisine and neighborhood, plus daily food news and recent openings.

feeds.title: Minimalist Baker
feeds.description: Sharing simple, delicious plant-based and mostly gluten-free recipes. Minimalist Baker is about celebrating simple cooking with recipes that require 10 ingredients or less, 1 bowl, or 30 minute or less to prepare.

feeds.title: Hummingbird on High Blog
feeds.description: My name is Michelle. I am the baker, blogger, and photographer behind Hummingbird High. Here you'll find well-tested dessert recipes, cake decorating tutorials, and baking techniques that will help save you time in the kitchen.

feeds.title: Urban Bliss Life
feeds.description: Food, wine, travel guides: easy family-friendly recipes, wine pairings & wine reviews, culinary & wine travel guides from food, wine, and travel pro Marlynn Schotland.

feeds.title: A Girl Worth Saving
feeds.description: Simple, Flavorful, and Healthy Recipes from bestselling author Kelly Bejelly creator of A Girl Worth Saving. Find recipes for special diets like Gluten free.

feeds.title: Sugar Geek Show
feeds.description: Browse hundreds of incredible cake and baking recipes all with step-by-step directions and tutorials. Then, stick around for cake tutorials and courses to take your decorating skills to the next level! Authored by Liz Marek, an award-winning cake decorator, instructor, and Author.

feeds.title: Sip Bite Go
feeds.description: Make easy restaurant style recipes for your family and friends. Grilling, Sous Vide Cooking, Smoker recipes, Pizza recipes, and more.

feeds.title: Portland Food and Drink
feeds.description: Your source for information and news for Portland, OR restaurants with wine, festivals, special dinners and much more.

feeds.title: The Kitchen Paper
feeds.description: Hi, I am Mary, and I seriously LOVE to cook! Welcome to The Kitchen Paper, where I will share with you tidbits about my cooking, running, yoga, travel, and life in general.

feeds.title: Local Haven
feeds.description: A food and lifestyle blog by Ashley Marti. She is a Creative director, food and prop stylist based in Portland, Oregon. A well known in the community as a food writer that leans towards simple recipes with big flavor that highlight seasonal and local produce.

feeds.title: Pechluck's Food Adventures
feeds.description: I am Pech. This blog chronicles adventures in eating, dining out, and cooking and imbibing with an appreciation for local Portland deliciousness or wherever travels may lead me.
